rfis: Site control: ALTA title commitment (current within 90 days), vesting deeds, all leases/options/easements with recordation status, parcel list with APNs, total controlled acreage (site_acres is null; test against ~5-7 ac/MW, i.e., ~500-700 acres for 100 MW), and an ALTA/NSPS survey.

Zoning and land use: Ventura County RMA zoning verification letter for every parcel, General Plan designations, SOAR applicability analysis, Williamson Act contract status and any non-renewal/cancellation filings, and all County pre-application meeting records.

Permitting: complete permit matrix with dates and status; all agency correspondence; CEQA status (NOP, draft EIR schedule, or MND) or intended CEQA pathway; any CEC AB 205 Opt-In application if filed.
Storage specification: BESS MW and MWh, duration, augmentation plan, chemistry (needed to assess CEC AB 205 eligibility at 200 MWh and fire-code scope).

Interconnection: CAISO interconnection request and queue number, cluster study phase and results, TPD allocation group, network-upgrade cost estimates, security postings, and draft or executed LGIA; if not in queue, intended cluster window and readiness.

Offtake and revenue: executed PPA/tolling/RA agreements or term sheets with counterparty, tenor, price, delivery point, and conditions precedent; RA contracting status; merchant revenue build-up (CAISO solar value ~$27/MWh, ancillary services, RA); curtailment assumptions vs ~11.5% CAISO solar curtailment.

Financial model: CAPEX by line item (test vs $1.43-1.56/Wac solar plus ~$200-350/kWh BESS), DSCR at P50/P90 (1.20x P90 benchmark), contingency (5-10%), debt sizing, sources and uses, tax-equity structure, ITC vs PTC election, and curtailment/degradation/network-upgrade sensitivities.

Tax-credit eligibility (kill criterion): BOC evidence package under Notice 2025-42 (physical work test only; no 5% safe harbor above 1.5 MW) establishing BOC before July 4, 2026; continuity plan; prevailing wage and apprenticeship plan (Notice 2022-61); domestic-content strategy (Notice 2023-38); FEOC/prohibited-foreign-entity analysis under OBBBA.

EPC and supply chain: EPC agreement or term sheet; module supply agreement with domestic-content certification, UFLPA traceability, AD/CVD exposure; BESS supply agreement with integrator and cell supplier, cell allocation, FEOC status; GSU/large transformer POs with production slots and delivery dates (128-144 week benchmark); racking/tracker/MV equipment status; full BOM.

Technical studies: geotechnical report, Phase I ESA, hydrology/drainage/flood study, glint/glare analysis (Oxnard and Camarillo airports), noise study, protocol biological surveys, cultural resources survey, Alquist-Priolo fault analysis, wildfire risk assessment.
BESS safety: UL 9540 listings, UL 9540A test reports, NFPA 855 design, emergency response plan, Ventura County Fire Protection District correspondence.
Schedule: integrated milestone schedule from entitlement through NTP to COD, reconciled against 18-30 month CEQA benchmark, ~5-year CAISO IR-to-COD timeline, and 128-144 week transformer lead times.
Community and tribal: engagement plan and records, any Community Benefits Agreement, known opposition, NAHC Sacred Lands File results, AB 52 consultation records.
Insurance: broker quotes or indications for construction and operational coverage including wildfire liability and BESS thermal-runaway coverage.
Data room index: complete document list with dates, authors, versions; the data room currently contains zero documents, so full population is required before cross-examination.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Resource Management Agency (RMA), Planning Division
agency_actions.action: Obtain written zoning verification and General Plan designations for all APNs; confirm Planned Development Permit/CUP requirement; obtain written SOAR applicability determination (whether voter approval is required) and hold a formal pre-application meeting.
agency_actions.why: Unresolved zoning kill criterion; Ventura County SOAR measures can force a countywide vote for solar on agricultural/open-space land, fatal to schedule.
agency_actions.deadline: Pre-app meeting within 30 days; written zoning/SOAR verification within 45 days

agency_actions.agency: California Energy Commission (CEC), AB 205 Opt-In Certification (Pub. Res. Code sec. 25545)
agency_actions.action: Decide go/no-go on the Opt-In pathway (solar >=50 MW and storage >=200 MWh); if elected, file the application so CEC's ~270-day environmental review governs entitlement.
agency_actions.why: Consolidated state path with defined timeline in lieu of county review; eligibility unknown until storage MWh is disclosed.
agency_actions.deadline: Decision within 60 days; file by Q3 2026 to protect COD

agency_actions.action: With developer authorization, confirm queue position, cluster study phase and results, TPD allocation group, and network-upgrade cost estimates; if not queued, prepare for the next annual cluster window.
agency_actions.why: No interconnection evidence; CAISO IR-to-COD ~5 years, ~20% of queue reaches COD, network-upgrade cost shock is the top dropout driver.
agency_actions.deadline: Confirmation within 30 days of authorization; next cluster window (typically April)

agency_actions.action: Confirm point of interconnection, Participating TO facilities scope, transmission vs wholesale-distribution path, substation capacity, and cost responsibility.
agency_actions.why: Ventura County is SCE territory; SCE facilities scope drives CAPEX and schedule and is undocumented.

agency_actions.agency: California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW), South Coast Region 5
agency_actions.action: Open early consultation on CESA species and sec. 1602 LSAA; set protocol survey scope (arroyo toad, least Bell's vireo, coastal California gnatcatcher, California condor) and any sec. 2081 ITP need.
agency_actions.why: No biological surveys exist; missing a survey season adds a year; unmitigable take is fatal.
agency_actions.deadline: Initiate within 60 days; surveys in spring 2026 season

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Ventura Fish and Wildlife Office
agency_actions.action: Pull IPaC species list; establish Section 7 (via USACE nexus) or Section 10/HCP strategy.
agency_actions.why: Federal listed-species exposure unassessed; consultation path sets survey scope, mitigation cost, timeline.
agency_actions.deadline: Species list within 30 days; strategy memo within 90 days

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Los Angeles District
agency_actions.action: Submit approved jurisdictional delineation; confirm Nationwide Permit 51 eligibility and PCN requirements.
agency_actions.why: No delineation exists; WOTUS impacts drive sec. 404/401 path and federal ESA/NHPA nexus.
agency_actions.deadline: JD submittal within 90 days; PCN before any fill

agency_actions.agency: Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board (Region 4) and State Water Board
agency_actions.action: File sec. 401 Water Quality Certification if a 404 nexus exists; enroll in the Construction General Permit (Order 2022-0057-DWQ) via SMARTS with a SWPPP.
agency_actions.why: 401 certification gates USACE authorization; CGP coverage is mandatory before construction.
agency_actions.deadline: 401 with USACE submittal; SMARTS NOI 30 days before ground disturbance

agency_actions.agency: California Department of Conservation, Division of Land Resource Protection, and Ventura County Agricultural Commissioner
agency_actions.action: Obtain written Williamson Act contract status for every parcel, any non-renewal/cancellation filings, FMMP designations, and preserve compatibility findings.
agency_actions.why: Williamson Act contracts can prohibit solar; cancellation carries penalties; status unknown and a potential second land-use kill criterion.

agency_actions.action: Submit BESS package for preliminary fire-code review: NFPA 855, UL 9540/9540A, hazard mitigation analysis, emergency response plan, access, water supply, defensible space.
agency_actions.why: BESS fire approval is gating; no safety documentation exists; Ventura wildfire exposure elevates scrutiny.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Air Pollution Control District (VCAPCD)
agency_actions.action: Confirm Rule 55 fugitive-dust plan requirements and whether any stationary sources need VCAPCD permits.
agency_actions.why: Construction air compliance unaddressed; affects schedule and SWPPP/dust-control scope.

agency_actions.agency: Native American Heritage Commission; Barbareno/Ventureno Band of Mission Indians; Santa Ynez Band of Chumash Indians
agency_actions.action: Request Sacred Lands File search; coordinate AB 52 consultation through the CEQA lead agency.
agency_actions.why: No cultural/tribal records; AB 52 consultation is mandatory and unaddressed resources can stop entitlement.
agency_actions.deadline: NAHC request within 30 days; consultation opened with CEQA notice

agency_actions.agency: IRS and U.S. Treasury (via tax counsel)
agency_actions.action: Execute BOC strategy under Notice 2025-42 (physical work test) before the OBBBA July 4, 2026 deadline; document PWA (Notice 2022-61), domestic content (Notice 2023-38), and FEOC material-assistance compliance.
agency_actions.why: Kill criterion: solar ITC/PTC is zero without documented BOC by July 4, 2026 (or PIS by Dec 31, 2027); no BOC package exists.
agency_actions.deadline: Hard deadline: BOC physical work documented before July 4, 2026

agency_actions.action: If offtake is with a CA IOU/CCA, confirm PPA approval path and timeline and RA counting eligibility for the solar-plus-storage configuration.
agency_actions.why: CPUC approval timing can be a PPA condition precedent; RA value depends on CPUC counting rules.

agency_actions.action: File Form 7460-1 if structures or glare fall within Oxnard/Camarillo airport approach surfaces; complete glint/glare analysis.
agency_actions.why: Airport-proximity glare/obstruction unassessed; can force redesign.
agency_actions.deadline: 7460-1 at least 45 days before construction; analysis within 90 days

verification_requests: CAISO (with developer authorization): verify queue number, cluster, study phase, TPD group, network-upgrade cost estimate, and security posting status directly.
SCE: verify interconnection facilities scope, cost responsibility, and earliest feasible energization date in writing.

Offtaker(s): confirm directly with the counterparty that the PPA/tolling/RA agreement is executed (or term sheet authentic), including price, tenor, delivery point, CPs, and credit support; do not rely on developer copies.
Transformer/GSU OEMs (Hitachi Energy, Siemens Energy, GE Vernova, Prolec GE, Hyundai): verify POs, production slots, and delivery dates vs the 128-144 week benchmark.
BESS integrator and cell supplier (Tesla, Fluence, Sungrow, CATL, BYD): verify supply agreement, cell allocation, delivery schedule, UL 9540/9540A reports, and FEOC status.
Module supplier: verify supply agreement, domestic-content certification for the 10-point ITC adder, UFLPA traceability, and AD/CVD exposure.
Title company (First American, Fidelity, Chicago Title): obtain the commitment directly; verify vesting, exceptions, encumbrances, mineral rights, and insured acreage vs claimed site control.
Ventura County RMA: independently verify zoning, General Plan designations, SOAR status, and any pre-app records or pending applications.
Ventura County Agricultural Commissioner / Dept. of Conservation: verify Williamson Act contract numbers, status, and any cancellation/non-renewal filings of record.
Independent engineer: lender's-engineer review of energy yield (P50/P90), curtailment vs ~11.5% CAISO solar curtailment, CAPEX vs $1.43-1.56/Wac plus $200-350/kWh BESS, and schedule feasibility.
Market revenue: independent CAISO study validating ~$27/MWh solar value, ~$52/kW-yr battery merchant revenue (2025), ancillary services, and RA price assumptions.
Insurance broker: verify insurability and pricing for wildfire liability and BESS thermal-runaway coverage with at least two markets.
Independent tax counsel: written opinion that the BOC package satisfies the Notice 2025-42 physical work test and the FEOC analysis is supportable.
Lead-time benchmarking: cross-check all quoted lead times against Wood Mackenzie, LBNL, and NREL indices rather than developer assertions.
conditions_precedent: Complete data room: every RFI delivered and indexed; no material category (title, zoning, interconnection, offtake, EPC/supply, model, tax-credit evidence) may remain empty.

Zoning kill criterion resolved: written RMA verification that solar+storage is permissible on all parcels, plus written confirmation that no SOAR vote or Williamson Act barrier applies, or a filed CEC AB 205 opt-in preempting local zoning.
Tax-credit kill criterion resolved: documented BOC under Notice 2025-42 before July 4, 2026, with independent tax-counsel opinion, continuity plan, and PWA/domestic-content/FEOC documentation.
Interconnection: executed LGIA or Phase II results with network-upgrade costs within budget and security postings funded; credible energization path vs the ~5-year CAISO benchmark.

Offtake: executed PPA/tolling/RA-plus-merchant structure with a creditworthy counterparty covering a board-approved minimum share of energy, independently verified; CPUC approval conditions identified.
Underwriting: model showing DSCR >=1.20x at P90, contingency >=5-10%, CAPEX within or justified vs $1.43-1.56/Wac plus $200-350/kWh BESS, and revenue consistent with verified CAISO market values.
Site control: ALTA title commitment with no fatal exceptions covering the full footprint (~500-700 acres), leases/options executed, recorded, and coterminous with the financing term plus extensions.
CEQA path confirmed: county EIR schedule consistent with COD or filed CEC opt-in, with the 18-30 month entitlement benchmark in the integrated schedule.
Long-lead equipment: binding POs with confirmed production slots for GSU/large transformers (128-144 weeks) and BESS, delivery supporting COD, with LD protection.
Environmental: protocol surveys complete with no unmitigable impacts; CESA/ESA strategy agreed with CDFW/USFWS; JD submitted; sec. 404/401/1602 path confirmed.
BESS safety: Ventura County Fire Protection District acceptance of the NFPA 855 package, UL 9540A reports, and emergency response plan.
Insurance: bound or committed construction, operational, wildfire, and BESS thermal-runaway coverage at pricing consistent with the model.
Tribal/cultural: NAHC Sacred Lands File search complete and AB 52 consultation opened with no unresolved objections.
Re-verification: all third-party verification requests returned with no material discrepancies against developer claims.
